text_sanskrit: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु । मामेवैष्यसि युक्त्वैवमात्मानं मत्परायणः ॥ ९-३४ ॥
itrans: manmanA bhava madbhakto madyAjI mA.n namaskuru . mAmevaiShyasi yuktvaivamAtmAnaM matparAyaNaH .. 9-34 ..
translation: Give thy mind to Me; be thou My devotee; offer thy sacrifices to Me; prostrate thyself before Me; having thus used thy mind and made Me thy goal, thou shalt surely come unto Me. (34)
